tei:titleStmt.tei:title: אַף־עַל־גַב דַּאֲנָא
Af Al Gav Da-ana — an original Aramaic “Meturgeman piyyuṭ” for Simḥat Torah by Isaac Gantwerk Mayer

tei:div.tei:head: Af Al Gav Da-ana — an original Aramaic “Meturgeman piyyuṭ” for Simḥat Torah by Isaac Gantwerk Mayer

tei:lg.tei:l: Although I am small in wisdom,
I will stand here to finish and begin the translation of the Torah.
On the eighth day that is called “Gathering,”
The twenty-second of the month of Tishri, twenty-third in diaspora,
The troops of the beloved people went out from the sukkah,
The wedding-chamber of the groom who rejoices with the bride,
Within the festival greatest of all occasions in joy,
As referred to by the name of the sukkot of temporary dwelling.
Now is its own time, according to the experts of law.
It it distinguished after it for six matters.
And your mnemonic is PaZe”R KeShe”V, as we were taught in a baraita,
which is in the fourth chapter of the tractate:
The swiftest of the priesthood ran to a new lottery.
We bless the time and Sheheḥeyanu is the blessing.
It is its own festival, and it is unnecessary to reside in sukkot.
One bull is to be offered as a wholly burnt offering.
The bearers of the sacred vessels changed the song.
The form of “Ya’aleh v-Yavo” is changed in prayer.
This day we say “Returning wind and bringing down rain” in the blessing of Strength,
Added in an additional service to come in the land, and already added in the nations.
But fifty days come between Pesaḥ and the prior gathering!
Why do we not wait until the ninth month?
On account of the winter rain, which is the ultimate trouble
Thus the Blessed Holy One said, “Wait with Me here.”
An allegory I will allege: what is this matter like?
A king of flesh and blood who was hosting a feast.
“Let us invite guests from seventy nations,
Let us eat and drink and rejoice all week!”
At the end of the days he said to one faithful one,
“The crowds have left. You, stay here in my domain!”
Seventy offerings they offered for seventy nations,
So only one ox and one ram are for burnt-offerings.
King Solomon dedicated a palace in the dedication of the House.
He pleaded and prayed on this day and slaughtered many sacrifices.
His prayer was on behalf of his people with him from the wadi of Egypt to the ascent of Ḥamat,
And he cried out and said “May you wholeheartedly keep Their commandments in awe!” (I Kings 8:61)
They slaughtered 22,000 cattle and 120,000 sheep
Before the Blessed Holy One, Hearer of all prayer.
Permission to double it to fourteen days Ḳohelet acquired with understanding.
The greatest of priests and scribes kept this day with the Tirshatha.
The people heard the holy word written in the Torah.
They struck their thighs and returned in repentance.
Our rabbis established to read all the Torah once a year.
“Finish it now,” they said, “and immediately start the Torah.”
Days of awe have all passed, from the new year;
The great fast ten days after it, days of repentance,
The festival of sukkot five days after the atonement of sin.
These occasions are holy, and on them we say words of praise.
Hence even upon Moshe our teacher rose the angel of death,
Whose domain is over all people since the day they were expelled from the garden.
Moshe said, “Please, let me pass, that I may see the good land!”
The Master of Eternities did not accept him, and said, “Go up to the mountaintop.”
He spoke in the plain of Moab after forty years,
All this copy of the Torah on the day his soul left.
It was his birthday, as is the portion of the righteous.
His soul left him on the seventh of the month of increasing in happiness.
On that day our master received his portion in truth
Nebo was prepared to accept him by the hands of ministering angels.
The prophet of prophets said on the day he received death
Blessings for all the tribes, for each son of the whole he gave one blessing:
Reuben should not die, and his sons should receive an inheritance.
Splendor to Judah, to do retribution on those who hate him.
Levi was found faithful, as he was tested at the waters of strife.
A shield on Benjamin, in whose land the Presence dwells.
He said to Joseph that Manasseh had thousands, Ephraim myriads.
Honors of Zebulun, with Issachar joined, on the mountain of the House.
First of the people Gad entered, receiving what was his first.
To Dan he said: Dan is mighty as a lion’s whelp.
The Galilee’s west and south are Naphtali’s portion.
Over all sons blessed is Asher, strong as youth.
There is no god but our God, whose Presence is in heaven.
Wine and grain the land makes with the dew of good.
Moshe lay down after this and the prince of death came.
He received his soul in the bond of life in the paradise garden.
And thus, with permission of the sages of the people, on the day of the rejoicing of the Torah,
I will translate today two orders of sealing,
From the last to the first, and from mourning to beginning.
The great prophet I will honor with the translation of “And this is the blessing...”

tei:note.tei:p: Shmini Atseret is distinguished from Sukkot in six ways.
Shavuot, also called “Gathering” in rabbinic texts.
An expression of self-reproach. Find Jeremiah 31:19
Deuteronomy, which is largely the final speech of Moses. Find Deuteronomy 17:18.
All of the following twelve lines, up to “the dew of good,” are based on Onkelos’ translation of the blessings in Deuteronomy 33.
